ModMetaData.name: Latios' Arsenal
ModMetaData.author: UNSCLatios
ModMetaData.description:
[h1][b]Latios' Arsenal (拉帝欧斯的军械库)[/b][/h1]
[b]Summary[/b] Latios' Arsenal is organised into content packs: salvaged mechanoid launchers, and medical biofoam kit. Open the mod settings and switch on only the packs you want in this colony - a switched-off pack is stripped before the game builds its defs, so it never enters the running game.
[h2][b]Content packs[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [b]You choose what loads.[/b] Options, then Mod settings, then Latios' Arsenal. Each pack has a switch. Because the decision has to happen before the game reads its content, a change takes effect the next time the game starts, and the settings screen tells you when a restart is pending. [*] [b]Switched-off means not loaded.[/b] A disabled pack's items, recipes and ammunition entries are removed before they exist, so they cost nothing at runtime and cannot appear in trades, quests or raids. [*] [b]Saves keep their own record.[/b] Every save stores which packs were active when it was written. If you load it after changing the switches, the message log lists what was turned off or on, so a missing tool or a newly available one is never a mystery. [/list]
[img]图片展示：模组设置里的两个内容包开关，分别对应武器与医疗内容[/img]
[h2][b]Pack - weapons: mechanoid salvage launchers[/b][/h2] [list] [*] Five launchers built from machine wreckage: the compact BL bullpup pattern, and the heavier shoulder-fired HL pattern. The BL-66 and HL-66 feed the 66mm thermal bolt, the BL-80 and HL-80 feed the 80x256mm fuel cell, and the HL-164 fires the 164x284mm demolition shell. [*] They use the mechanoid heavy ammunition itself, so rounds stripped from a battlefield fit straight into a launcher. [*] The bullpup guns are loaded one round at a time - six in the 66mm, three in the 80mm. The shoulder-fired guns swap the whole rotary magazine instead: six, three or two rounds in a single, slower reload. [*] The bullpup pattern unlocks with basic mechtech and fabrication; the heavy pattern with high mechtech and fabrication. Both are built at the fabrication bench from steel, components and mechanoid slag. [/list]
[h2][b]Pack - medical: biofoam[/b][/h2] [list] [*] A belt-mounted biofoam injector. When the wearer starts bleeding out - one full unit of bleeding per day or more - it spends a charge and seals the worst bleeding wound immediately at a fixed 75% dressing quality, so the colonist stops losing blood while a doctor is still on the way. [*] Four charges to start with, one per trigger. Refilling is a job, not a magic button: the wearer walks to a unit of medicine (or pulls it from their pack), spends a few seconds loading the canister, and gets two charges back. [*] The check is driven by taking damage, with a slow backup check for other sources of bleeding, so a colony wearing these does not pay for a per-tick health scan. [*] Crafted at the machining table once medicine production is researched. [/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b] Built for RimWorld 1.7. The weapons pack needs Combat Extended (it uses Combat Extended ammunition and verb behaviour); the mod's code needs Harmony. The weapon research paths use Biotech mechtech projects, so Biotech is required as well. Nothing in the base game or in Combat Extended is modified - the mod only adds its own content and its own settings.
[b]Credits[/b] Combat Extended for the ammunition, warhead behaviour and mechanoid weapon baselines the launchers are balanced against. Harmony for the framework the mod's health check runs on.
------
[h1][b]Latios' Arsenal (拉帝欧斯的军械库)[/b][/h1]
[b]简介[/b] 拉帝欧斯的军械库按“内容包”组织：一套用机械族废料拼装的发射器，和一套医疗生物泡沫装备。在模组设置里只打开你这个殖民地需要的内容包——被关掉的内容包在游戏读取 Def 之前就被整段摘掉，根本不会进入运行中的游戏。
[h2][b]内容包[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [b]加载什么由你决定。[/b]选项 → 模组设置 → Latios' Arsenal。每个内容包一个开关。由于必须在游戏读取内容之前决定，开关改动会在下一次启动游戏时生效，设置界面会标明「已改动 —— 重启游戏后生效」。 [*] [b]关掉就是没加载。[/b]被关闭内容包的物品、配方、弹药条目在生成之前就被移除，所以运行期零开销，也不会出现在交易、任务或袭击里。 [*] [b]存档自己记录状态。[/b]每份存档都会记住保存时哪些内容包是开着的。改过开关之后再载入它，消息栏会列出被关闭或被开启的内容，东西突然消失或突然可用都不会莫名其妙。 [/list]
[img]图片展示：模组设置里的两个内容包开关，分别对应武器与医疗内容[/img]
[h2][b]内容包 - 武器：机械族回收发射器[/b][/h2] [list] [*] 五把用机械残骸拼装的发射器：紧凑的无托 BL 系列，和更重的肩扛 HL 系列。BL-66 与 HL-66 打 66mm 热能弹，BL-80 与 HL-80 打 80x256mm 燃烧弹，HL-164 打 164x284mm 爆破弹。 [*] 它们直接使用机械族自用的重型弹药，战场上捡到的炮弹可以直接塞进发射器。 [*] 无托型号逐发压弹：66mm 六发、80mm 三发。肩扛型号直接更换整个转轮弹舱：六发、三发或两发一次装完，单次装填更慢。 [*] 无托型在基础机械科技与精密装配后解锁；重型型需要高级机械科技与精密装配。两者都在精密装配台制作，材料是钢铁、零部件和机械族残块。 [/list]
[h2][b]内容包 - 医疗：生物泡沫[/b][/h2] [list] [*] 腰带式生物泡沫注射器。当穿戴者开始大量失血（每天一个完整单位以上的流血速度）时，它消耗一次充能，以固定 75% 的包扎质量立刻封住最严重的那处出血伤口——医生还在路上时，殖民者已经不再继续掉血。 [*] 初始四格充能，一次触发用掉一格。补充充能是一个作业而不是魔法按钮：小人会走到医药处（或直接取用随身携带的医药），花几秒装填药罐，换回两格充能。 [*] 检测由「受伤」驱动，另有一条低频兜底检查覆盖其他失血来源，所以整支队伍都戴着它也不会产生逐 tick 的健康扫描开销。 [*] 研究出医药生产后，可在机械加工台制作。 [/list]
[b]兼容性与前置[/b] 面向 RimWorld 1.7。武器内容包需要 Combat Extended（使用它的弹药与射击行为），模组代码需要 Harmony；武器研究线使用 Biotech 的机械科技项目，因此也需要 Biotech。本模组不修改原版与 Combat Extended 的任何内容，只新增自己的内容与设置项。
[b]致谢[/b] Combat Extended：弹药、弹头表现与机械族武器基准均来自它。Harmony：健康检测所依赖的框架。
